title: Broncos' Sean Payton takes jab at Falcons fans during preseason game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos' Sean Payton takes jab at Falcons fans during preseason game
sources.description: Sean Payton has long had a rivalry with the Falcons, dating back to the beginning of his 15-year tenure with the Saints. He stoked it again on Friday.
